passages.text: Demo Medical Supply is a medical device distributor with about 40 employees and four departments: Sales, Technical Service, Regulatory and Quality, and Administration.
Demo Medical Supply distributes products from two manufacturers: blood pressure monitors and infusion pumps from Corvane Medtech, and ultrasound systems and probes from Lumiden Instruments.

Sales handles quotations and hospital accounts; Technical Service handles installation, maintenance, and calibration; Regulatory and Quality handles product registration and the warranty policy; Administration handles HR, finance, and general affairs.
